member.name: T:MyMath.Matrix
member.summary: Provides static methods for performing matrix operations on integer arrays.
member.remarks: The Matrix class contains utility methods for transforming two-dimensional integer arrays. All methods are static and can be called without creating an instance.

member.name: M:MyMath.Matrix.Divide(System.Int32[0:,0:],System.Int32)
member.summary: Divides every element in a two-dimensional integer matrix by the given divisor.
member.remarks: This method creates a new matrix with each element equal to the corresponding element of the input matrix divided by using integer division. If is null, the method returns null. If is zero, the method prints an error message and returns null.
member.param: A two-dimensional integer array to divide. If null, the method returns null.
The integer divisor to apply to every element. Must not be zero.
member.returns: A new two-dimensional integer array with each element divided, or null on invalid input.
